messages:
eva: kicked off v5.0 canary to ap-south ~6m ago. quick smoke passed but smokebot alerted intermittent 502s on /v1/embeddings.

deploy-bot: Deploy v5.0 -> canaries deployed (3/3). tag: v5.0.0.

smokebot: synthetic-run -> /v1/embeddings returned 2 failures of 5 samples; both from aps-can-02. p95 ~2x baseline.

sam: checking logs on aps-can-02: repeated 'kv fetch timeout' and small prefill backlog reported.

eva: can we run a focused curl against aps-can-02? posting snippet.

eva: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://aps-can-02.api.redwood/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" -d '{"text":"smoke"}' -w "\n%{http_code} %{time_total}\n"
```

eva: results x4: 200 0.12, 502 0.40, 200 0.11, 200 0.10. intermittent.

infra: host metrics -> kv_prefill_backlog=7 workers=1.

sam: hypothesis: prefill workers too low on that host. running targeted prefill now with concurrency=3.

eva: prefill output: queued 5 prefixes -> processed 5 -> completed in 16s.

smokebot: rerun synthetic -> 5/5 success for /v1/embeddings on aps-can-02. p50/p95 restored.

sam: recommendation: proceed with rollforward after 15m observation and pin v5.0 to canaries for 8h. enable alerts for embeddings p99 and kv_prefill_backlog>5 for 8h.

eva: updating internal changelog: note about transient prefill backlog on aps-can-02 causing brief 502s; mitigation executed. hold public release note until observation passes.

infra: filed INFRA-7011 to increase default prefill workers and expose startup progress metric.

eva: oncall checklist for the window: 1) monitor p99 2) confirm prefill drain on newly added hosts 3) if error rate >4% over 5m, pause rollout.

sam: i'll watch channel for next hour.

eva: thanks everyone. closing thread after observation if stable. :thumbsup:
